thought.text: Wizard complete; redirected to bootstrap-mode OIDC login. Now I'll drive the Dex authorization-code + PKCE flow with curl:

reasoning_content:
Step 3 complete → redirect to /admin/login/start?mode=bootstrap. This starts a bootstrap-mode OIDC login via Dex with PKCE.

Now I need to run the OIDC authorization code + PKCE flow via curl:
1. GET /admin/login/start?mode=bootstrap → 302 to dex authorize with state, nonce, code_challenge. Cookies saved in cookies.txt (Phoenix session).
2. Login to Dex: GET /dex/login → form, POST credentials kai@example.com / changeme → redirect to /dex/consent (skipApprovalScreen: true so it might skip consent) → redirect to /dex/.../login/callback?code=...
3. Follow with the same cookie jar (dex session) → redirect to redirect_uri (http://localhost:8008/admin/callback?code=...&state=...) — note that the callback is on port 8008, not 8080.
4. GET that callback URL with the admin session cookies → token exchange, verify, save bootstrap claim, and (in bootstrap mode) render the claim selection page inline → 200 with select-claim form.
5. Parse the admin_group_claim_choice values, pick instance_admin, and POST to /admin/bootstrap/select-claim with CSRF token + cookie.
6. → 302 /admin/dashboard; admin session established. Bootstrap complete.

Dex login flow:
- GET http://localhost:5556/dex/login → returns HTML containing a CSRF token in the form (Dex uses a csrf token in the form: hidden input name="csrf" value=...).
- POST email, password to /dex/login. Dex sets a session cookie, then redirects to /dex/consent?request=... (if skipApprovalScreen is set, might go directly to the login callback). With skipApprovalScreen: true and skipLoggingScreen: false, after login it redirects to consent... actually skipApprovalScreen skips the consent screen, so after login it goes directly to the callback with code.

Dex flow: /dex/login (GET form) → POST → redirect to /dex/consent?request=... → if skipApprovalScreen, does consent auto-approve? Actually skipApprovalScreen: "Skips the approval screen. If set to true, clients will not be prompted for consent." After login Dex redirects to /dex/consent?request=...; with skipApprovalScreen the consent page auto-submits? Hmm, no. Let me just follow the redirects with curl -L and see what happens. But I need to handle the initial form POST manually, so:

- curl -c dex.txt -b dex.txt GET http://localhost:5556/dex/login -o dex_login.html → extract csrf
- curl -c dex.txt -b dex.txt POST http://localhost:5556/dex/login -d email=kai@example.com -d password=changeme -d csrf=$CSRF -D headers -o /dev/null → check location (should be /dex/consent?request=...)
- Follow location with GET → if consent page appears, extract and submit; with skipApprovalScreen it might redirect directly to the callback.

After that, the final redirect URL points to http://localhost:8008/admin/callback?code=X&state=Y — request it with the admin session cookie jar (cookies.txt).

Note that the callback URL's host is localhost:8008 — reachable.

Let's run the flow. First step: initiate login.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt --max-time 10 -D start_headers.txt -o start_body.html \
  "http://localhost:8080/admin/login/start?mode=bootstrap" -w "login/start: [%{http_code}]\n"
grep -i location start_headers.txt | sed 's/^\(location: \).*$/\1/i' | head -1 | cut -c1-300
